summary: Independently verified 'My Assignments' + Field Photo Capture for RoofSpan. Backend: 3/3 assignments tests (test_assignments.py) + 1/1 new photo-category test (test_photo_categories.py) pass against the public preview URL. Frontend E2E via Playwright: owner can view section-assignment, assign lead via lead-assign-select dropdown, sees success toast, value persists after reload, can unassign (Unassigned option works), and same works on JobDetail via job-assign-select. Sales user sees only assigned leads (1 lead visible: Photo Lead) and LeadDetail assignment control is read-only (lead-assigned-readonly present, lead-assign-select absent). All acceptance criteria from the review request met.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/mobile.py upload_photo: still no MAX_BYTES guard on await file.read() (called out in iter_8). Low-priority hardening for photo uploads.

routers/mobile.py list_photos/photo_content: still require only get_current_user (no per-record RBAC). Any authenticated user can read any photo id if guessed. Consider joining to lead/job assignment for sales users.
GET /api/audit assertion in test_assignments only checks presence of 'lead.assign' action — does not assert the row belongs to the specific lead. Adequate for MVP but could be tightened.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (owner assign lead+job, persistence, unassign, sales read-only visibility all verified)
